name: Chaotic Crescendo
description: When the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes. Each creature within 15 feet of the creature must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (2d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. When the creature is reduced to 0 hit points roll once on the Sorcerer's Wild Magic table and proceed with the following effect.
